quote: Anago-meshi and the rice sets are seasoned with Japanese soy-sauce-based tare, which standardly contains wheat; no wheat-free seasoning is mentioned.
found: The cited /en homepage names the dishes but says nothing about seasoning. One click away, /en/menue1 ("restaurant menu", linked from the /en nav) states it outright: "purely domestic natural conger eel simmered in a sweet secret sauce on top of soy sauce rice cooked with a secret recipe" — repeated for the Conger eel set meal. The Japanese original (mirrored on umahiro.jp) reads 「秘伝のレシピで炊き込んだ醤油ご飯の上に甘めの秘伝タレで煮込んだ純国産天然アナゴ」.
http: 200 plain curl for /en, /en/menue1, /en/menue2, /en/menue3 (Wix site, server-rendered — no JS workaround needed)
method: plain fetch of the cited page, then its own menu subpages
note: Claim is true and stronger than recorded — the rice itself is 醤油ご飯 (soy-sauce-cooked), not just a tare on top — but the cited /en root does not carry it. Repoint to /en/menue1. Also gluten-relevant on that page and not yet recorded: フライ oysters, 穴子天丼-style tempura, and pork loin katsu, all wheat-crumbed.

quote: Menu is centered on conger eel and oysters with fish-based seasonings; no vegan or vegetarian items are listed.

The three menu subpages confirm the absence of any plant-based item: every listed dish is conger eel, clam, oyster, or pork cutlet, and even the school-trip bento carries momiji manju (egg/flour).

note: Supported, with one over-claim to trim: nothing on the site says the seasonings are fish-based — the anago is described as simmered in a sweet secret tare over soy-sauce rice. Say 'soy-based seasonings' instead of 'fish-based seasonings'; the vegan verdict is unaffected.

Also: the record's website field https://miyajimashokudo.jp/ is NXDOMAIN, and tabelog's listed homepage http://www.miyajima-shokudo.jp/menu.html is NXDOMAIN too; the only Wayback capture of miyajimashokudo.jp (2025-01-07) is the site of みやじま食堂別館, a different, mainland branch. quote: The shop deep-fries wheat-batter momiji manju; there is no gluten-free menu and no published statement about a dedicated fryer, so cross-contamination should be assumed.
found: Cited /about/: 「紅葉堂のもみじまんじゅうのふんわりふっくらとしたカステラ生地に、料理人とともに試行錯誤し作り上げました独自の衣をまとわせ天ぷらにし、販売を開始し」, and the same page records 「平成18年　紅葉堂弐番屋をオープン…揚げもみじ®をはじめ…が、カフェスペースにて楽しめます」, so the statement is branch-specific. The wheat is spelled out on the same site: /zairyo 「小麦 瀬戸内の国産小麦100%に切り替え」, and momijido.com/pdf/allergy_2024.pdf lists 小麦粉 as a core ingredient of all six varieties. /agemomi/ describes the coating as 「揚げもみじ®専用生地」 mixed with water — a flour batter.
http: 200 plain curl for /about/, /zairyo, /agemomi/, /shop; the allergy PDF fetched 200 and read with pdftotext -enc UTF-8 -nopgbrk

note: Supported and then some. Strengthen the citation with https://momijido.com/pdf/allergy_2024.pdf — it is a per-product allergen table with 小麦粉 ticked on every line, which is far better evidence than a company-history page, and it confirms there is no gluten-free variant to ask for.

quote: Cream and cheese fillings (dairy) are prepared in the same kitchen as the anko items, and the castella batter contains egg; no separation for vegan diners is documented.
found: Cited /about/: 「紅葉堂では、伝統のこしあんのほか、つぶあん、抹茶、クリーム、チョコレート、チーズを製造しており」 — one maker, one line, dairy and bean paste together. The egg half is on the same site rather than this page: /zairyo 「卵 純国産鶏「もみじ」の卵を100%使用…このもみじ卵を100%使用する事でたくさん空気を含んだカステラ生地ができ」, and the allergy PDF lists 卵 in every single variety including 【こしあん】 「あん（砂糖、小豆） 卵 砂糖 小麦粉 水あめ」.
http: 200 plain curl throughout; PDF via pdftotext -enc UTF-8 -nopgbrk
method: plain fetch of the cited page, then /zairyo and the allergy PDF for the egg claim
note: Supported, but cite the allergy PDF for the egg statement — /about/ does not mention egg. The PDF is also grounds for a tier change (see the vegan_status recommendation): egg is in the bean-paste item too, so nothing at this shop is vegan.

why: The operator's own allergen table lists 卵 in all six momiji manju varieties — 【こしあん】「あん（砂糖、小豆） 卵 砂糖 小麦粉 水あめ」 — so even the plain bean-paste item is not vegan, and クリーム/チョコレート/チーズ add 乳. /shop states Nibanya's entire range is 「揚げもみじ®、揚げもみソフト、ドリンクセット」, i.e. the fried manju plus a dairy soft serve. There is no plant-based item to have 'limited' access to.
